title: 3dfim+
description: Program to calculate the cross-correlation of an ideal reference waveform with the measured FMRI time series for each voxel.

first_image.description: Number of first dataset image to use in the cross-correlation procedure (default = 0)
first_image.title: Number of first dataset image

last_image.description: Number of last dataset image to use in the cross-correlation procedure (default = last)
last_image.title: Number of last dataset image

baseline_polynomial.description: Degree of polynomial corresponding to the baseline model (default: 1). Use -1 for no baseline model.
baseline_polynomial.title: Degree of baseline polynomial

threshold.description: FIM internal mask threshold value (0 <= p <= 1) to get rid of low intensity voxels (default: 0.0999)
threshold.title: Threshold value

cdisp_value.description: Write (to screen) results for voxels whose correlation stat. > cval (0 <= cval <= 1; default: disabled)
cdisp_value.title: Correlation display value

ort_file.description: Input ort time series file name. Can be used multiple times.
ort_file.title: Ort file

ideal_file.description: Input ideal time series file name. Can be used multiple times.
ideal_file.title: Ideal file

output_params.description: Output the specified parameter. Can be used multiple times. Possible values are: 'Fit Coef', 'Best Index', '% Change', 'Baseline', 'Correlation', '% From Ave', 'Average', '% From Top', 'Topline', 'Sigma Resid', 'All', 'Spearman CC', 'Quadrant CC'.
output_params.title: Output parameters

output_bucket.description: Create one AFNI 'bucket' dataset containing the parameters of interest, as specified by the '-out' commands. The output 'bucket' dataset is written to a file with the prefix name bprefix.
output_bucket.title: Output bucket prefix
